name: research
summary: Answer a question that spans several sources, products or subtopics

steps.goal: Answer one sub-question from primary sources with cited rows
steps.verify: open two cited URLs and confirm they say what the rows say
steps.fan_out: one subtask per sub-question or source family, ids lane-<topic>

steps.goal: Recheck every load-bearing or surprising claim (versions, limits, prices, defaults) against its source
